recentItems.description:
For more latest songs & videos, subscribe 👉 https://bit.ly/Saregama_Telugu

Presenting the video song, "Etthara Etthu" from Comrade Kalyan, starring Sree Vishnu, Mahima Nambiar, Radhika Sarathkumar, Shine Tom Chacko, Upendra Limaye, and others. Directed by Janakiram Marella, with music composed by Vijai Bulganin.
